name: sb-materials-hardware-node-tests
description: Node-native regression harness for sb_materials_hardware's MaterialsHardwareCatalog OWL component. Same rationale as southbrook_kitchen_3d_configurator/tests/node_js (see its README): this environment has no headless-Chromium binary, so Hoot can't run here. Mounts the REAL catalog.js under jsdom + the real @odoo/owl package (pinned to the same vendored 2.8.2), with catalog.xml's actual templates and a stubbed orm service — no DOM/WebGL surface needed, this component is plain OWL + a table.
